# North Atlanta Automotive

> Independent auto repair shop at 7095 Jimmy Carter Blvd, Peachtree Corners, GA 30092.
> Serving Peachtree Corners, Norcross, Duluth, Berkeley Lake and Doraville since 2018.
> Phone (770) 676-7030. Open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. 4.7 stars from 162 Google reviews.

Not a dealership and not a franchise. Technicians are salaried rather than paid commission, so
there is no financial incentive to recommend unnecessary work. Every job includes a digital
vehicle inspection: photographs and video of the actual problem are texted to the customer, who
approves or declines each line item before any work begins.

Note on location: the shop is physically in Peachtree Corners. The 30092 ZIP code has carried a
Norcross mailing address for decades, so many customers refer to it as a Norcross shop. Both refer
to the same location at 7095 Jimmy Carter Blvd.

## Georgia emissions (Gwinnett County)
Verified against Georgia's Clean Air Force for 2026 registration.

- [Emissions hub](https://northatlantaautomotive.com/emissions/) — who needs testing and when
- [Failed emissions repair](https://northatlantaautomotive.com/emissions/failed-emissions-repair/)
- [Check engine light emissions failure](https://northatlantaautomotive.com/emissions/check-engine-light-emissions-failure/)
- [Georgia emissions repair waiver](https://northatlantaautomotive.com/emissions/emissions-repair-waiver-georgia/)

Key facts: petrol vehicles model years 2002–2023 under 8,500 lbs GVWR require testing in Gwinnett
County for 2026 registration. The three most recent model years (2024–2026) and vehicles 25 years
and older (2001 and older) are exempt, as are diesels. The test fee is capped at $25 and includes
one free retest at the original station within 30 calendar days. A lit check engine light is an
automatic failure. The repair waiver minimum for 2026 registration is $1,176 in qualifying repairs.
North Atlanta Automotive is a repair shop, not a testing station.
